name: Ascend
flavor: A gust of wind wraps around you and carries you skyward.
effect:
You move up to 5 tiles straight up and up to 2 tiles in any other direction. 
Creatures have disadvantage on reactive strikes made in response to this movement.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the distance 2 tiles up and 1 tile in another direction

name: Blinding Flash
flavor: A searing burst of light erupts from your outstretched hand.
effect:
One creature within range must attempt a Fortitude save.
Success: The target is dazzled for one turn.
Failure: The target is blinded for one turn and dazzled for one minute.
Critical Failure: The target is blinded for one minute.
While affected, the target can spend one action to attempt the save again, removing all remaining effects on a success.

name: Chill
flavor: Frost crawls from your fingertips across the target's skin.
effect:
You freeze one medium-or-smaller creature or object you touch, dealing 3d4 cold damage with a basic Fortitude save.
Critical Failure: The target is partially frozen; its move speed is reduced by 2 tiles next turn.
If the target is standing in water, it takes a −3 penalty to the save.
If you spend two actions on this spell, the range increases to 3 tiles.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 2d4

name: Control Water
flavor: Water bends to your will, flowing into whatever shape you desire.
effect:
You shape and manipulate water within range, creating simple shapes, redirecting small rivers, forming temporary barriers, or shaping small tools of water. 
The water returns to its natural state when the spell ends. This spell does not offer permanent control.

name: Darken
flavor: Shadows pool at point in range, swallowing the light
effect:
You create a zone of darkness centered on a point within 10 tiles, covering up to 9 connected tiles. 
The zone blocks non-magical light.
If you spend 3 actions on this spell, the zone can cover up to 15 tiles.

name: Earthglide
flavor: You skim across the ground in a line, turning in harsh gravel behind you
effect:
You glide along the ground, moving up to 6 tiles in a line. 
Every tile you move across becomes rough terrain.
If your next action is casting an Earth spell, it costs 1 action less.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the distance by 3 tiles

name: Featherfall
trigger: You see a creature or group of creatures falling
target: A group of creatures up to your INT/WIL
flavor: You form a blanket of soft wind unfurls beneath the falling.
effect:
You guide a group of falling creatures within rabge gently to the ground. 
They fall at a speed of 10 tiles each round, take no fall damage, and land standing. 
You cannot use this spell on creatures larger than medium.
upcast:
At Adept: You can use this on Large Creatures
At Grand Magus: You can use this on Huge Creatures

name: Ferrokinesis
target: One unenchanted metal object of light weight or less
flavor: Metal hums and tears free at your command.
effect:
You move one unenchanted metal object of light weight or less up to 6 tiles. 
If you move it into your space, you may catch it with a free hand.
If the object is held, the holder can attempt a Fortitude save to resist the movement. Enchanted metal and artifice typically bear runes that prevent being moved by spells.
You can instead hurl the object at a creature in range, dealing 2d8 physical damage with a basic Reflex save.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d8

name: Firebolt
flavor: A bolt of flame leaps from your palm toward your foe
effect:
You hurl a bolt of fire at one creature within range, dealing 2d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save.
Critical Failure: The target is set on fire, taking 1d6 persistent fire damage.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d6

name: Flameshape
flavor: Fire dances as you will
effect:
You manipulate flames within range, lighting candles, creating patterns, or shaping flames for visual effects. 
This spell cannot deal damage directly.
If cast as a Complex spell, you can also change the color of fire.
upcast: By Rank: You can control an additional fire

name: Gentle Breeze
flavor: A cool, soothing breeze rolls out from you.
effect:
A refreshing breeze washes over creatures in a 2-tile burst centered on you, easing the heat of the day or the tension of a social gathering. 
The first time each day a creature is affected by this spell, it loses one level of exhaustion.
If you spend 3 actions on this spell, the burst increases to 3 tiles.

name: Glide
flavor: The wind catches you and carries you along its current.
effect:
Allows the caster to glide down with the wind. 
Gives the caster a Glide speed equal to their land speed for the turn. 
After casting the spell the caster can glide as a free action.

name: Glow
target: One object or creature of size small or smaller
flavor: A soft radiance blooms beneath your touch.
effect:
You cause one object or creature of small size or smaller to glow, spreading bright light for 4 tiles and dim light for 4 tiles beyond that, for one minute. 
The light can be dismissed with an action.
If the target is a creature or a held object, the creature can attempt a Reflex save to resist the spell.

name: Gravel Spray
flavor: You sweep your arm forward and a wave of stinging gravel erupts from the ground.
effect:
You hurl a barrage of gravel in a 4-tile cone, turning the area into difficult terrain
Creatures in the area take 2d4 physical damage with a basic Fortitude save. 
If you spend 3 actions on this spell, it deals 3d4 damage and the cone extends to 5 tiles.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d4

name: Gust
flavor: A wall of wind bursts from you, scattering everything in its path.
effect:
You create a sudden burst of wind against one creature or object within range, pushing away small objects, unbalancing foes, or snuffing out small flames. A light object is pushed 4 tiles back. This spell cannot push creatures of large size or larger.
If the target is a creature, it must attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save.
Success: The target is knocked back 1 tile or knocked off-guard 1 (it's choice)
Failure: The target is knocked back 2 tiles and knocked off-guard 2
Critical Failure: The target is knocked back 4 tiles and falls prone.
For each additional action you spend on the spell, the knockback increases by 2 tiles.

name: Heat
flavor: Warmth radiates from your palm, deepening into a searing heat.
effect:
You heat one medium-or-smaller creature or object you touch, dealing 2d4 fire damage with a basic Fortitude save. The heat can be lessened to instead warm food or objects to a pleasant temperature.
If the target is a creature affected by an Ice spell, you may attempt to thaw it, giving it a new save against that effect.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 2d4

name: Icy Floor
flavor: Frost races across the ground from where you point.
effect:
You freeze the ground in a 9 connected within range for one minute. 
Any creature that walks across the ice must attempt a DC 13 Acrobatics check or fall prone. 
If another effect would cause a creature standing on the ice to fall prone, it takes a −5 penalty to that check

name: Ignite
flavor: A spark snaps from your fingers onto the target.
effect:
You set one flammable object or creature within range on fire for up to one minute. If the target is a creature, it can attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save.
Failure: The target is set on fire, taking 1d8 persistent fire damage.

name: Illusory Object
flavor: Weave threads of shimmering magic into a familiar shape.
effect:
Weave an illusion of an stationary object or creature in range 
The object is medium or smaller and anything can pass through it.
upcast:
At Adept: You can use this create Large Illusions
At Magus: You can use this create Huge Illusions
At Archmage : You can use this create Gargantuan Illusions

name: Interpose Earth
trigger: You would have to make a Reflex save
flavor: Stone and soil leap up to shield you from harm.
effect:
You hurl a nearby piece of earth to block part of the attack, making the triggering Reflex save with a +3 modifier.
You can instead cast this spell when an ally within 3 tiles would have to make a Reflex save, granting them the bonus. If you do, the spell gains the Complex trait.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the modifier by 1

name: Magnetic Field
flavor: An invisible hum of repelling force surrounds you.
effect:
You surround yourself with a field that repels metal. 
You gain a +4 bonus to Reflex saves against metal weapons and projectiles.

name: Magnetic Rebound
trigger: You would have to make a Reflex save against an attack by a metal weapon or projectile.
flavor: You twist the incoming metal aside with a flick of magnetism.
effect:
You move the metal out of way, using your Spellshaping check instead of making a Reflex save against the triggering attack.
Critical Success: You may select another valid target for the attack instead.

name: Magnetize
flavor: Infuse a target with magnetic magic, causing metal to fly towards it.
effect:
You magnetize one creature you touch, drawing metal toward it. The target must attempt a Will save.
Success: The target is magnetized for one round.
Failure: The target is magnetized for one minute.
Critical Failure: The target is magnetized for one minute, and the effect is doubled.
While magnetized, the target takes a −2 penalty to Reflex saves against metal weapons and projectiles.

name: Metal Shards
flavor: Shards of metal tear free and streak toward your foes.
effect:
You shoot three small shards of metal at targets of your choice within range. Each shard deals 1d4 physical damage with a basic Reflex save.
If you spend 3 actions on this spell, you shoot one extra shard.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the amount of needles by 1

name: Mold Earth
flavor: The earth rises and bends at your gesture.
effect:
You shape small bits of earth within range. 
You can raise a 2-tile-high, 1-tile earthen pillar that provides greater cover, or turn 4 adjacent tiles rough, creating difficult terrain.
With more time, you can craft simple shapes and constructions out of earth, though they fall apart after an hour.

name: Momentary Acceleration
flavor: A flash of temporal magic accelerates your allies
effect:
Choose a number of creatures within range up to your INT. 
They gain Hastened 1 for one turn.

name: Move with the Wind
flavor: The wind flows around you, and you move as one with it.
effect:
You connect to the wind, gaining a +2-tile bonus to your movement speed and a +2 bonus to Reflex saves. 
When you cast or sustain this spell, you may Stride (or traverse with another movement speed), treating difficult terrain one step less.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the modifiers by 1

name: Muddy Ground
flavor: The ground softens into a sucking mire beneath your enemies.
effect:
You turn up to 15 connected tiles within range muddy, slowing those who walk over it. 
The area becomes difficult terrain for up to an hour.
upcast: At Magus: Turn the ground into greater difficult terrain instead

name: Null
flavor: A touch of null magic tears into the aura of a target
effect:
You use rare void magic to tear through magical defenses, dealing no physical damage but striking at auras. The target must attempt a basic Will save.
Failure: The target takes 3d4 aura damage. This damage only targets auras and magical defenses, dealing full damage to auras.
If the target has no aura or magical defenses, this spell has no effect.
Every extra action you spend on the spell increases its damage by 2d4.
Void magic is dangerous: on a failed spellshape, you take half the aura damage instead.

name: Quick Jet
flavor: A burst of flame at your back hurls you across the battlefield.
effect:
You propel yourself forward in a line, traveling up to 6 tiles and treating difficult terrain one step less. 
This movement does not trigger reactive strikes.
You can use this spell to cross gaps, though you fall if you end your movement in midair. 
You may instead travel 4 tiles diagonally up or down
upcast: By Rank: Increase the movement distance by 2

name: Rock Toss
flavor: Loose stone leaps from the ground into your hand and then into the air.
effect:
You throw a bit of loose earth or a rock at one creature within range, dealing 1d6 physical damage with a basic Reflex save.
If you spend 2 actions on this spell, you throw a larger rock, dealing 1d10 damage.
If you spend 3 actions on this spell, you throw an even larger rock, dealing 1d12 damage. Additionally on a critical hit 
the target is knocked prone.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage dice amount by 1

name: Shadowstrike
flavor: The darkness itself coils and strikes.
effect:
You make the shadows attack. 
Choose a tile of darkness or shadow within range with a creature adjacent to it; that creature must attempt a Reflex save.
Failure: The target takes 2d8 piercing damage.
This spell deals an extra 1d8 damage on a critical hit.

name: Slip
trigger: You see another creature in range take the Stride action
flavor: A slick sheen of water flashes beneath your target's feet.
effect:
You manipulate water or ice beneth a creature. It must attempt a Reflex save.
Success: The creature must stop its movement or become off-guard 1 until the end of your next turn.
Failure: The creature falls prone.
Critical Failure: The creature falls prone and takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.
The creature has disadvantage on the save if it is on wet, slippery, or icy ground.

name: Soul Ward
flavor: A temporary ward washes of any soul magic that would affect you
effect: You project an invisible field around yourself, gaining a +5 bonus to WIL saves against spells, attacks, and effects with the Soul trait, and a +1 bonus to other WIL saves.
upcast: At Grand Magus: The spell does not need to be sustained

name: Sturdy as Stone
flavor: Your skin hardens with the patience of the mountain.
effect:
You infuse yourself with earth, gaining resistance 5 to physical damage and a +3 bonus to Fortitude saves, but your speed is reduced by 1 tile.
If you would become prone or off-guard, you may dismiss this spell to avoid the condition. The benefits stop working while you are in the air.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the modifiers by 1

name: Water Bullet
flavor: A bullet of preassured water fires from you hand
effect:
You strike one creature within range with a compressed bullet of water, dealing 2d12 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save.
If you stand in or next to water, this spell costs only 2 actions to cast.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d10

name: Water Push
flavor: A torrent of water surges from your outstretched hands.
effect:
You blast one creature within range with water. It must attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save.
Success: The target is pushed back 1 tile.
Failure: The target is pushed back 3 tiles.
Critical Failure: The target is pushed back 3 tiles and becomes off-guard 2.
For each size category above Medium, the target is pushed 2 tiles less.
If you are standing in water or spend 3 actions on this spell, it instead targets all creatures in a 5-tile line from you, and it gains the Draining trait.

name: Zap
flavor: A thin arc of lightning snaps through the air.
effect:
You send a fast bolt of electricity at one creature within range, dealing 1d10 lightning damage. 
The target makes a Reflex save with a −4 modifier if it wears metal armor or holds a metal object; otherwise the modifier is −2
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d8

name: Accelerate Self
flavor: Time skips, and you act before the moment catches up.
effect:
You move in a burst of speed, gaining Hastened 3 this turn. 
You cannot be affected by Accelerate Self again for 1d4 turns.
upcast: At Grand Magus: Gain Hastened 4 instead

name: Air Bubble
flavor: A sphere of clean air hovers around your head.
effect:
You create a bubble of breathable air around one creature, allowing it to breathe in environments without breathable air, such as underwater or in toxic areas.
When you cast the spell, you can extend the bubble to adjacent tiles. If you do, the spell costs 3 actions and gains the Draining trait.

name: Barricade
flavor: Stone and metal surge upward into a protective wall.
effect:
You form a barricade of metal or stone across 5 connected tiles within range. 
The barricade provides cover, and you choose whether it blocks line of sight.
If you spend 3 actions on this spell, the barricade is 8 tiles long.

name: Beam of Light
flavor: A blinding ray of light sweeps out from your outstretched hand.
effect:
You cast a beam of light in a 1-tile-wide, 6-tile-long line from you. Creatures in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.
Success: The target is dazzled for one turn.
Failure: The target is blinded for one turn and dazzled for one minute.
Critical Failure: The target is blinded for one minute.
While affected by this spell, a target can spend one action to attempt the save again, removing all remaining effects on a success.

name: Breathe Fire
flavor: A roaring gout of flame pours from your jaws.
effect:
You breathe a cone of fire. Creatures in the cone take 3d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. 
The cone is 4 tiles with 2 actions, or 6 tiles with 3 actions.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d6

name: Conjure
flavor: The simplest form of teleportation magic brings an inaminate object into your hand
effect:
You teleport one medium-or-smaller item within range bearing a Conjuration rune you have drawn to you. 
If you have a free hand, you may catch it.
upcast:
By Rank: Double the range
At Grand Magus: You can conjure Large items

name: Detect Metal
flavor: You can sense metal around you
effect:
You gain a precise metalsense with a range of 5 tiles, working through non-magical materials. 
You can detect creatures holding or wearing metal within range.

name: Dispel
flavor: Magic unravels beneath your focused will.
effect:
You attempt to counteract a spell or magical effect on one creature or object you touch. 
Use your Spellshaping check against the Spellshaping check of the spell's caster. 
On a success, the effect ends on the target. 
The target's check gains a +3 bonus for each rank their spell is higher than the rank you cast this spell at.

name: Earth Tremor
flavor: The ground bucks and heaves around you.
effect:
You cause the earth to shake in a 4-tile burst around you. Creatures other than you in the area take 1d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex or Fortitude save.
Failure: The target falls prone.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the size of the burst by 1 tile

name: Earthen Armor
flavor: Plates of stone seal around your body like a second skin.
effect:
You form armor of hardened earth or stone around yourself. 
It counts as heavy armor, but you are proficient with it even without armor proficiency. 
The armor grants resistance 8 to physical damage and resistance 4 to elemental damage. 
It has a Weak Point Difficulty of 10 and grants a +3 bonus to Fortitude saves and Athletics checks. 
While wearing it, your move speed is reduced by 2 tiles, and it imposes a −3 armor penalty.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the physical resistance by 2 and elemental resistance by 1

name: Earthen Launch
flavor: The earth itself hurls you skyward.
effect:
You boost yourself away with a burst of earth magic, jumping up to 5 tiles up and 7 tiles in any direction. 
You take no fall damage as long as you fall a shorter distance than you jumped. 
You must be on solid ground connected to the earth to cast this spell.
If you land on a creature, it must attempt a Reflex save.
Failure: The creature takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

name: Electrify
flavor: Lightning coils hungrily along the blade.
effect:
You electrify a melee weapon you touch, causing it to deal an additional 1d12 lightning damage on a hit.
If the weapon falls into water, or the wielder fails a save from an effect with the Water trait, the spell ends and lightning zaps all creatures in a 2-tile burst, dealing 2d10 lightning damage with a basic Fortitude save.
upcast: At Grand Magus: Increase the damage by 1d12

name: Flame Jet
flavor: A roaring torrent of flame erupts from your hands.
effect:
You unleash a jet of flame in an 8-tile straight line from you, dealing 2d8 fire damage to all creatures in its path with a basic Reflex save.
You can choose to be pushed up to 3 tiles away from the direction of the flame. This movement does not trigger reactive strikes.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d8

name: Heat Metal
flavor: Heat metal to blazing temperatures
effect:
You heat one metal weapon or set of metal armor you touch. The holder or wearer can attempt a Reflex save to avoid the effect.
Failure: The item becomes heated, dealing 2d4 fire damage at the start of the holder's turn.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d4

name: Heatwave
flavor: The air shimmers and bakes everything it touches.
effect:
You create a 6×6-tile area of scorching air within range. 
Creatures in the area take 2d4 fire damage with a basic Fortitude save.
Critical Failure: The target also gains one level of exhaustion.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 2d4

name: Hone Edge
flavor: The blade's edge gleams, impossibly keen.
effect:
You sharpen one metal weapon, or up to five pieces of ammunition, that deals slashing or piercing damage. 
It deals an additional 1d8 damage for the duration.
upcast: At Grand Magus: Increase the damage by 1d8

name: Ice Shard
flavor: A jagged spear of ice forms and flies in the same motion.
effect:
Throw a shard of ice against a target, dealing 3d6 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save. 
On a critical failure the damage dice of this spell increases to d10's
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d6

name: Illusory Wall
flavor: Create an the illusion of a wall in the way
effect:
You conjure an illusory wall within range, taking any shape you want. 
The wall is up to 6 tiles long and up to 3 tiles high, can appear solid or passable, and can be used to hide creatures behind it. 
Creatures, objects, and projectiles pass through the wall, and any creature that sees something pass through can find it.

name: Inflame
flavor: Flames wreath your body, hungry for anyone who comes close.
effect:
You conjure flames on yourself, harmless to you but dangerous to others. 
Any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 1d6 fire damage, and your unarmed melee attacks deal an extra 1d6 fire damage.
When you cast or sustain this spell, you can make an unarmed melee strike as part of the same action.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d4

name: Levitate
flavor: Gravity loosens its grip on the target.
effect:
You levitate the target 1 tile off the ground. When you sustain the spell, you can move the target up or down 3 tiles. 
A floating creature takes a −2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, but can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself, negating the penalty for the rest of its turn.
If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or stable terrain, it can move across the surface by climbing (if vertical) or crawling (if horizontal, such as a ceiling). 
Creatures with a Glide speed have a Flight speed while affected, ignoring the downsides.
An unwilling target can attempt a Reflex save to avoid the effect, and make a Fortitude save to grab onto something if they would be moved up or down by the spell.

name: Lightning Shroud
flavor: Lightning crawls over your skin, eager to bite.
effect:
You surround yourself with crackling electricity. 
Any creature that hits you with a melee attack or grapples you takes 2d6 lightning damage, and you gain resistance 5 to lightning damage.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d6 and resistance by 3

name: Orbiting Earth
flavor: Stones rise and circle you like patient sentinels.
effect:
You shape three rocks or pieces of debris into projectiles that orbit you. 
While they orbit, you can use a reaction to interpose them against incoming strikes, making a Spellshaping check instead of a Reflex save.
When you sustain this spell, you can make an attack with one of the stones, dealing 1d10 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save.
Each time you block or attack, you lose one orbiter; if you run out of orbiters, the spell ends.
If you spend 3 actions on this spell, you raise four orbiters.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the amount of orbiters by 1

name: Propel
trigger: You see an ally stride within reach
flavor: A gust of wind at your ally's back turns their stride into a dash.
effect:
You push an ally who just took the Stride action with a gust of wind, increasing its movement by 2 tiles, or 4 tiles if it moves directly away from you. 
You can instead use this spell to grant an ally a +5 bonus to a Jump check.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the tiles moved by 2.

name: Purify Water
flavor: Tainted water clears as if filtered through years of stone.
effect:
You remove pollutants, toxins, and harmful substances from a body of water you touch, making it safe to drink. The water remains clean for up to 1 hour.
The first time each day a creature drinks the purified water, it loses one level of exhaustion.

name: Quick Forge
flavor: Metal flows like clay beneath your hands
effect:
You quickly repair or forge a simple metal object, such as a weapon, tool, or piece of armor. 
The object must be medium sized or smaller, and the result is functional but not masterfully crafted. 
The magic holding the object together fades when the spell ends, and it deforms or returns to its earlier state.
upcast: At Grand Magus: You can forge Large objects

name: Sense Water
flavor: You feel the pull of every drop of water around you.
effect:
You sense sources of water within 20 tiles, even hidden underground or behind obstacles, and can determine the direction and approximate distance to the nearest source.
You also have a +4 bonus against spells and effects with water trait while spell is active

name: Shadowbind
flavor: You bind a creature with tendrils of darkness
effect:
You make the shadows bind one creature within range standing in dim light or darkness. It must attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save.
Success: The target is slowed 1 for one round as the shadows try to grab it.
Failure: The target is grabbed by the shadows.
Critical Failure: The target is restrained by the shadow
While grabbed, the target is slowed 1. Effects that expose the shadows to magical light can attempt to break the spell, and a creature in bright light has advantage on saves to escape.

name: Shape Bone
flavor: Bone softens at your touch, then hardens into a new form.
effect:
You reshape a small bone or bone fragment into a simple tool, weapon, or decorative item, such as a bone dagger or needle. 
The reshaped bone retains its original durability and can be customized for specific purposes. 
The object must be no larger than what can be held in one hand.

name: Soul Sight
flavor: You see the bright sparks of souls
effect: You gain a soulsight as an impressive sense with a range of 10 tiles, and can use the Inspect Soul action while the spell is active
upcast: At Archmage: The spell does not need to be sustained

name: Stalagmite
flavor: The ground erupts in a spear of stone.
effect:
You cause a stalagmite to rise from the ground in an unoccupied space within range. It is 2 tiles tall and provides cover.
If cast under a creature, that creature must attempt a Reflex save.
Failure: The target is speared by the stalagmite, taking 3d6 piercing damage and becoming pinned until it succeeds at an Athletics check against your Spellshaping roll.

name: Steam Cloud
flavor: A hissing bank of steam swallows the battlefield.
effect:
You create a 4x4-tile cloud of steam within range that obscures vision. 
Creatures within the cloud take a −5 penalty to visual perception checks. 
The cloud dissipates if exposed to strong wind.
If your last action was casting a Water or Fire spell, this spell costs only 1 action.

name: Tailwind
flavor: A steady wind gathers at the target's back.
effect:
A gust of wind propels one creature within range, increasing its movement speed by 2 tiles for the duration. 
The target can move in any direction but must move at least 1 tile each turn, or the spell ends.

name: Teleport
flavor: Space folds, and you are simply elsewhere.
effect: You teleport to a tile you can see within range.
upcast: By Rank: Double the range of the spell

name: Tremor Sense
flavor: You feel every footstep in the earth
effect:
You sense vibrations through the ground, granting you a precise Tremor Sense with a range of 12 tiles. 
This can reveal hidden or invisible creatures, but does not detect flying or hovering creatures.
upcast: At Grand Magus: The spell does not need to be sustained

name: Water Arm
flavor: You conjure an extra arm out water
effect:
You create a tentacle of water that can grab things or attack. 
While the spell is active, you have the Water Tentacle strike, which has a range of 4 tiles, deals 2d6 bludgeoning damage, and has the Grab and Shove traits. 
The arm can grab and open things like a normal arm within its range.
Each conjured water arm also grants you a climb speed of 2 tiles while it's not grabbing a creature.
upcast: By Rank: Increase amount of water arms by 1

name: Water Ball
flavor: A churning sphere of water hangs in the air
effect:
You create a hovering ball of water 2 tiles across. When you cast or sustain the spell, you can move the ball up to 3 tiles. 
Any creature that moves into the ball, or that the ball moves into, must attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save.
Failure: The target becomes trapped in the ball.
Trapped creatures are carried along with the ball and can attempt Athletics checks to escape. Creatures with a swim speed can swim out without a check.

name: Water Breathing
flavor: You connect to the water and breathe in
effect:
You can breathe water as if it were air and use verbal components underwater. 
You also have advantage on saves against deep-sea pressure and similar dangers.
upcast:
At Magus: Increase the duration to 10 Minutes
At Grand Magus: Increase the duration to 1 Hour
At Archmage: Increase the duration to 8 Hours

name: Water Walk
flavor: The surface of the water holds beneath the target's feet.
effect: One creature you touch can walk on the surface of water or other liquids as if it were solid ground, moving at its normal speed without needing to balance.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the amount of targets by 1

name: Wave Dash
flavor: You ride a cresting wave as it slams into your foes.
effect:
You create a slamming wave, a 4-tile cone of water from your position, dealing 2d6 bludgeoning damage to creatures in the area with a basic Fortitude save.
Failure: The target is pushed 2 tiles along with the wave.
Critical Failure: The target is pushed 4 tiles along with the wave.
You may choose to ride the wave, arriving anywhere on the edge of the cone.
If you cast this spell while in water, the cone is 6 tiles long and the spell deals 2d8 damage.

name: Wind Wall
flavor: A howling curtain of wind springs up across the battlefield.
effect:
You create a wall of strong wind within range, 10 tiles long and 3 tiles high. 
The wall blocks gaseous forms, such as clouds, and imposes a −4 penalty to ranged attack rolls passing through it.
Medium or smaller creatures attempting to move through the wall must attempt a Fortitude save, being block on a failure

name: Whirlwind
flavor: A spiraling column of wind tears at everything it touches.
effect:
You create a whirlwind in a 3×3-tile area within range. 
Creatures in the whirlwind must attempt a Fortitude save at the start of their turn.
Failure: The creature is lifted 2 tiles into the air and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.
Critical Failure: The creature is lifted 4 tiles into the air and takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage.
When you sustain this spell, you can move the whirlwind up to 3 tiles, carrying creatures inside it. 
The first time each turn you move the whirlwind into a creature's space, that creature must attempt a Fortitude save.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the amount of tiles creatures are lifted by 1 and the damage by 1d6

name: Air Slice
flavor: An invisible blade of wind shears through the air.
effect: You send a swift slice of cutting wind at one creature within range, dealing 2d10 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d10

name: Blink
flavor: You flicker, and appear elsewhere
effect: With a quick flash of magic, you teleport to a tile you can see within range.
upcast: By Rank: Increase range by 6

name: Creeping Shadows
flavor: The darkness spreads like something alive, hungry for the light.
effect:
You create a zone of spreading darkness of up to 9 connected tiles within range, blocking out non-magical light. 
Any creature in the darkness at the start of its turn must attempt a Will save.
Failure: The creature becomes Frightened 1.
When you sustain this spell, you can extend the darkness by 3 tiles.

name: Dust Devil
flavor: A churning column of dust devours the light and the air itself
effect:
You create a 2-tile burst of whirling air and dust within range. 
When you create it or move it, creatures inside must attempt a Fortitude save.
Failure: The creature takes 1d8 slashing damage and takes a −3 penalty to perception checks and ranged attacks until it spends an action to clear the dust from its eyes.
When you sustain this spell, you can move the dust devil 3 tiles.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the burst size by 1 tile

name: Fire Whip
flavor: A lash of living flame coils in your hand, hissing.
effect:
You create a Fire Whip in one hand. 
It deals 2d6 fire damage, has a +2 item bonus to attack, a range of 4 tiles, and the agile, finesse, and deadly (d8) traits. It belongs to the flail weapon group.
When you sustain this spell, you can make a Strike with the weapon
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d4

name: Fireball
flavor: A bead of flame streaks out and blooms into an inferno.
effect: You create a 5-tile burst of fire at a location you can see within range, dealing 5d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save.

name: Fly
flavor: The wind accepts you as one of its own.
effect:
You gain a flight speed of 4 tiles. 
When you sustain this spell, you may Fly as part of that action.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the flying speed by 2

name: Giant Stone Hand
flavor: Stone grinds and rises, shaped like a hand waiting for orders.
effect:
You conjure a giant stone hand at a space you can see within range. The hand is a large creature with health equal to your Spellshaping roll and resistance 6 to physical and elemental damage.

When you cast or sustain this spell, and as a basic action, you may move the hand 3 tiles, restore 1d6 + your INT or WIL health to it, make a Grab attack, or position the hand to provide greater cover to adjacent allies. Grab attacks use your Spellshaping roll, deal 2d6 bludgeoning damage, and have the Improved Grab trait.

name: Hail of Nails
flavor: Shrieking metal rains from the sky
effect:
You create a rain of small metallic projectiles over an 8×8-tile area within range, dealing 3d6 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save.
The first time you sustain this spell each turn, you may spend an action to repeat the hail, targeting the same or a new area.

name: Haste
flavor: You slip a half-step ahead of the present moment.
effect:
By subtly manipulating the timestream, you move slightly faster than normal. You become quickened 1.
If you spend 3 actions on this spell, you can instead target an adjacent willing creature.

name: Lava Wave
flavor: A slow, glowing tide of molten rock rolls forward.
effect:
You summon a wave of lava from your position, up to 3 tiles wide and 1 tile thick. 
When you cast the spell and each time you sustain it, the wave travels 4 tiles forward. 
Creatures hit by the wave must attempt a Reflex save.
Failure: The target takes 4d8 fire damage.

name: Lightning Bolt
flavor: A blinding streak of lightning splits the air.
effect:
You hurl a bolt of lightning at one creature or object within range. 
The target makes a basic Reflex save, taking 4d12 lightning damage on a failure. 
The save takes a −4 modifier if the target wears metal armor or holds a metal object; otherwise the modifier is −2.

name: Shadowstep
flavor: The shadows take you, and set you down elsewhere.
effect: You step through the shadows and teleport to a tile in darkness or dim light within range.

name: Shunt
flavor: You shunt another creature through space
effect:
You teleport one creature or object you touch to a destination within 6 tiles. You cannot target creatures larger than Large.
An unwilling creature can attempt a Will save to resist.
Failure: You teleport the target to a destination within 6 tiles.
upcast:
By Rank: Double the range you can teleport the creature to
At Archmage: You can target Huge creatures

name: Slow
flavor: A target of your choice finds themselves out of sync with time
effect:
Effect: You subtly manipulate the timestream around one creature within range, slowing its movement and perception of the world. It must attempt a Will save.
Success: The target is slowed 1 for one round.
Failure: The target is slowed 1 for the spell's duration.
Critical Failure: The target is slowed 2 for the spell's duration.
The target can attempt the save again at the end of each of its turns.
upcast: By Rank: Choose one more creature

name: Thunder Rush
flavor: You become a crackling blur of motion.
effect:
You take on some of the speed of lightning. 
When you cast and sustain this spell, you can take the Stride action, and your move speed increases by 4 tiles. 
Creatures cannot make reactive strikes against your movement.
Once per turn, when you move adjacent to a creature, it takes 2d4 lightning damage.

name: Thunder Step
flavor: You vanish with a crack of thunder that impacts everything nearby.
effect:
Teleport to a tile you can see within range.
Creatures within 5 tiles of where you teleported to take 2d8 thunder damage with a basic Fortitude save

name: Water Jet
flavor: A screaming lance of water cuts across the battlefield.
effect: You create a high-pressure jet of water in a 1-tile-wide, 12-tile-long line from your position, dealing 4d8 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save.

name: Chain Lightning
flavor: Lightning leaps from foe to foe, never satisfied with just one.
effect:
You strike one creature or object within range with a bolt of lightning that then arcs to nearby creatures. 
The target makes a basic Reflex save, taking 3d12 lightning damage on a failure. 
The save takes a −4 modifier if the target wears metal armor or holds a metal object; otherwise the modifier is −2.
Whether it hits or not, you may then direct the spell to another target within 4 tiles, chaining to up to 5 bounces as it hits new targets.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d12

name: Cold Snap
flavor: The air cracks with a killing frost.
effect:
You create an impact of extreme cold at a point within range. Creatures in a 3×3-tile area around the point must attempt a Fortitude save.
Success: The creature takes half damage.
Failure: The creature takes 5d8 cold damage and becomes frozen 1.
Critical Failure: The creature takes double damage and becomes frozen 2.
Creatures in a 6×6-tile area around the point take half as much damage and are not frozen.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 2d8

name: Disintegrate
flavor: A searing beam of unraveling light leaves nothing but dust.
effect:
You send a beam of pure unraveling magic at one creature or object within range, dealing 5d12 force damage with a basic Reflex save. 
Shields, armor, and objects hit by Disintegrate are destroyed unless enchanted with anti-magic runes or made of Adamantium or Mithril.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 2d12

name: Fiery Body
flavor: You become a living flame
effect:
You turn your body into fire. 
While sustaining this spell, you cannot be grappled, restrained, or have your move speed reduced, and you are immune to fire damage and effects from fire spells. 
Any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 3d6 fire damage, and your unarmed melee attacks deal an extra 2d6 damage, all of it fire damage.
You can use a reaction to reform around a damaging attack or effect, improving the result of a Reflex save one step.
You have vulnerability 10 to cold damage and damage from water spells. 
While in water or restrained by water spells, you take 2d6 vital damage at the start of your turn.

name: Stasis
flavor: The target hangs motionless, a fly caught in amber-colored time.
effect:
You hold one creature or object of large size or smaller within range stuck in timespace. It must attempt a Will save.
Success: The target is Stunned 1.
Failure: The target is held in Stasis while you sustain the spell.
Critical Failure: The target is held in Stasis while you sustain the spell, and it has disadvantage on further saves against it.
While in Stasis, a creature or object skips its turn, cannot take reactions, and any effects it was causing or that were affecting it are suspended. 
Affected creatures roll a 1 on all saves (besides saves against Stasis). 
The first time each turn the target would make a save, take damage, be healed, or be affected by a new effect, it can attempt a new save against Stasis.

name: Steelskin
flavor: Your skin flows into seamless steel.
effect:
You cover your body with a layer of metal armor that doesn't hinder movement. 
You gain resistance 15 to physical damage, resistance 10 to fire, cold, and acid damage, and a +5 bonus to Fortitude saves.
The steel attracts lightning: you take a −4 penalty to saves against lightning effects.

name: Storm
flavor: Clouds boil overhead and the sky opens.
effect:
You conjure a storm of pouring rain and wind in a 100-tile area around you. 
All creatures under the storm clouds become wet, taking half damage from fire but double damage from ice and lightning. 
The storm obscures vision, imposing a −3 penalty to all visual perception checks.
If the spell is sustained for a minute, loose dirt and ground turn to mud, counting as difficult terrain.
upcast: At Archmage: The spell takes only 3 actions

name: Wall of Fire
flavor: A curtain of roaring flame splits the battlefield.
effect:
You conjure a wall of flames of 10 adjoining tiles within range. 
Creatures that start their turn in the wall, or that walk into it, take 4d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save.

name: Waterspout
flavor: A howling pillar of water punches skyward.
effect:
You create a 3-tile-burst, 10-tile-high waterspout within range. 
Creatures at that location must attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save.
Success: The creature takes half damage and is pushed up 3 tiles.
Failure: The creature takes 3d10 bludgeoning damage and is pushed up 8 tiles.
Critical Failure: The creature takes double damage and is pushed up 12 tiles.
Creatures pushed up by the spell fall down afterwards, taking fall damage as normal.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the damage by 1d10

name: Wind Walk
flavor: The wind bears you up like a fallen leaf that changed its mind.
effect: You select a number of creatures up to 4 + your INT (or WIL if cast as an Attuned Spell), and may include yourself. The chosen creatures gain a flight speed equal to their walking speed for the duration.
upcast: By Rank: Increase the flying speed by 2

name: Dimensional Net
trigger: You see a projectile within the spells range
flavor: Reality twists, and a shimmering net of elsewhere snaps open.
effect:
You conjure a dimensional net to catch an incoming projectile without the Dimensionalism trait. 
If your Spellshaping roll is higher than the projectile's, you catch it, stopping it before it hits its intended target. 
Caught projectiles are stored in the net while the spell is sustained.

Open Net (2 actions): Target a point within 5 tiles and set a direction. 
The projectiles fly forward in your chosen direction. If a projectile had a set target, you may select a new one.

If you fail to sustain the spell, the net collapses and the projectiles continue in the direction they were going before being caught.

name: Earthquake
flavor: The land itself revolts beneath your feet.
effect:
You shake the earth in a 200-tile burst around you. 
Any creature on land in the area must attempt a Fortitude save.
Failure: The creature is knocked prone and takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage.
This spell deals heavy damage to buildings and terrain. 
You may repeat the effect each time you sustain the spell.

name: Inferno
flavor: A primordial firestorm rages at your command.
effect:
You create a roaring 10×10-tile fire of primordial proportions at a location you can see within range, dealing 10d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save. 
The fire spreads to nearby flammable materials and cannot be put out by nonmagical means while you sustain it.
Water or Ice spells may attempt a contested check to put out part of the fire.

name: Miniature Sun
flavor: A miniature sun in the palm of your hand
effect:
You conjure a miniature sun that hovers in the air in front of you. It emits bright light for 8 tiles and dim light for 8 tiles beyond that. Any creature that moves into the bright light or ends its turn there must attempt a Fortitude save.
Failure: The creature takes 5d6 fire damage.
Creatures that target you with an attack must attempt a Fortitude save.
Failure: The attacker is Blinded for the turn.
You are immune to all negative effects of the sun.

name: Pyroblast
flavor: A river of white-hot flame pours forth, melting all before it.
effect:
You send a stream of superheated flame in a line up to 10 tiles long and 1 tile wide from you. 
Creatures in the area must attempt a Reflex save.
Failure: The creature takes 12d6 fire damage.
Due to the supernatural heat of the spell, fire resistance is half as effective against it.

name: Simulacra
duration: As long as you maintain them
flavor: A second you steps out of the magic, wearing your face.
effect:
You create a copy of yourself out of magic that appears exactly as you. When you create it, you may give it illusory clothes that appear normal but cannot be interacted with. The copy has 5d6 health and aura, and can take any action you can except those with the "Soul" trait. When it casts spells, reinforces its aura, or uses mana in any way, it uses your mana.

The simulacrum cannot be healed or benefit from potions or the like, but can spend an action to drain 1d8 of your mana, restoring that much health to itself. You always know the location of your simulacra. Simulacra can dismiss themselves as a free action.

After a long rest, you must spend mana equal to half this spell's cost per simulacrum you maintain.

name: Storm of Swords
flavor: A cyclone of steel rings and shimmers around you, hungry for targets.
effect:
You control an array of metal objects — often swords, spears, and other weapons — striking with unparalleled precision. 
When you cast or sustain the spell, you may throw up to 3 metal objects at creatures within range, dealing 3d8 physical damage each with a basic Reflex save.
Additionally, you may keep a number of metal objects hovering around you equal to your level + your INT + your WIL.
If at least 5 objects hover around you, any creature that starts its turn within 3 tiles or moves into the area must attempt a Reflex save.
Failure: The creature takes 2d8 physical damage

name: Sunbeam
flavor: The light of dawn itself lances out from your hands.
effect:
You create a massive beam of burning light, 5 tiles wide and 30 tiles long, from your position. Creatures in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.
Success: The target is dazzled for one turn and takes 4d6 fire damage.
Failure: The target is blinded for one turn, dazzled for one minute, and takes 8d6 fire damage.
Critical Failure: The target is blinded for one minute and takes double damage.
While affected by this spell, a target can spend one action to attempt the save again, removing all remaining effects on a success.

name: Tornado
flavor: A black, sky-striking funnel of wind howls into being.
effect:
You conjure a massive whirlwind in a 3×3-tile area, 20 tiles tall, within range. 
Creatures that start their turn in the area or enter it must attempt a Reflex or Fortitude save.
Failure: The creature takes 6d8 bludgeoning damage and is sucked up into the tornado, lifted 4 tiles.

Creatures stuck in the tornado move with it and are off-guard 4. At the start of their turns, stuck creatures take 6d8 bludgeoning damage and are lifted 3 tiles. They can spend an action on their turn to attempt an Athletics check against the spell to escape.
When you sustain the spell, you can move the tornado up to 6 tiles.

name: True Lightning
flavor: True lightning, bright as the sky arcs from you
effect:
You strike one creature or object within range with an extremely fast bolt of true lightning. 
The target makes a basic Reflex save, taking 8d12 lightning damage on a failure.
 The save takes a −16 modifier if the target wears metal armor or holds a metal object; otherwise the modifier is −8.

name: Tsunami
flavor: The horizon rises, and the ocean comes for everything.
effect:
You create a massive wave of water that crashes down on everything in its path. 
The wave is a 10-tile-wide line from your position (15 tiles wide if you are in water). 
It moves 5 tiles forward when you cast the spell, and at the end of each of your turns while the spell lasts. Creatures hit by the wave must attempt a Fortitude save.
Success: The creature takes half damage and is moved 1 tile back.
Failure: The creature takes 6d10 bludgeoning damage and is moved 3 tiles back.
Critical Failure: The creature takes double damage and is moved 6 tiles back.
